answer: The vault index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1487 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the velvet. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the oasis queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. A 280 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
